mapper.select:
WITH RECURSIVE MENU_TREE_NODE AS ( SELECT M.MENU_ID , M.MENU_NAME , M.MENU_TYPE , M.URL , M.PARENT_MENU_ID , M.SORT_ORDER FROM TB_MENU M WHERE M.MENU_ID IN
#{menuId}
AND M.DATA_STATUS = 'ENABLED'
UNION
SELECT P.MENU_ID , P.MENU_NAME , P.MENU_TYPE , P.URL , P.PARENT_MENU_ID , P.SORT_ORDER FROM TB_MENU P INNER JOIN MENU_TREE_NODE C ON P.MENU_ID = C.PARENT_MENU_ID WHERE P.DATA_STATUS = 'ENABLED' ) SELECT DISTINCT MENU_ID , MENU_NAME , MENU_TYPE , URL , PARENT_MENU_ID , SORT_ORDER FROM MENU_TREE_NODE ORDER BY SORT_ORDER
mapper.update: WITH RECURSIVE SUB_MENU AS ( SELECT M.MENU_ID FROM TB_MENU M WHERE M.PARENT_MENU_ID = #{menuId} UNION SELECT M.MENU_ID FROM TB_MENU M INNER JOIN SUB_MENU S ON M.PARENT_MENU_ID = S.MENU_ID ) UPDATE TB_MENU SET DATA_STATUS = #{dataStatus} , UPDATED_BY = #{author} , UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE MENU_ID IN (SELECT MENU_ID FROM SUB_MENU)
